# Logan Goodwin

Official personal website of Logan Goodwin: author, songwriter, technologist, humorist, and independent commentator.

Primary sections:
- /about/ — biography and brand overview
- /books/ — featured books and audiobook samples
- /music/ — selected original songs
- /commentary/ — commentary and humor
- /technology/ — cybersecurity and technology portfolio
- /videos/ — official channels and featured videos
- /contact/ — contact form

Complete publishing catalog: https://frontlinetechconsulting.com/
